name: chrome-devtools
purpose: Free alternative to browserbase. Authenticated browser via remote-debugging on port 9222. Persistent profile = LinkedIn / Substack auth survives reboots.
required_for_sde: optional — pick this OR browserbase, not both. Free but requires launcher script + Chrome/Canary installed.
manual_install: 4. Run it: ~/.codialectic/bin/launch-chrome-devtools-mcp.sh (opens Chrome Canary on port 9222 with persistent profile at ~/.codialectic/chrome-mcp-profile)
5. Log in to LinkedIn + Substack ONCE — sessions persist via the profile dir.
6. (Optional) Auto-start on boot — see chrome-devtools-launchagent.plist template for macOS LaunchAgent setup.
